mapper.sql: e.id, e.work_order_id, e.process_type_id, e.room_id, e.equipment_id, e.step_order, e.operator_id, e.operator_name, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.process_qty, e.key_process_params, e.status, e.remark, e.is_deleted, e.version, e.created_by, e.updated_by, e.created_time, e.updated_time, pt.process_name AS process_type_name, pt.process_code AS process_code, ri.room_name AS room_name, eq.equipment_name AS equipment_name, (SELECT tp.template_id FROM preparation_process_template tp WHERE tp.preparation_id = wo.preparation_id AND tp.process_type_id = e.process_type_id AND tp.step_order = e.step_order AND tp.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS template_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM work_order_process_execution e LEFT JOIN process_type pt ON e.process_type_id = pt.process_id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON e.room_id = ri.room_id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment eq ON e.equipment_id = eq.equipment_id AND eq.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN work_order wo ON e.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id AND wo.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND e.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.step_order ASC
SELECT e.id FROM work_order_process_execution e WHERE e.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND e.is_deleted = 0
